ProblemHypothesis

The journey is scattered across tools that do not know each other.

Trail access, rides, group coordination and gear live in different places.

  • 1

    Access is hard to trust

    Trail access sits in posts and pins with no evidence, expiry or moderation.

  • 2

    Group rides run on chat

    Chat groups and payment screenshots, with no roster or capacity.

  • 3

    Rides leave no record

    A good ride vanishes: no journal, no recap, no places reached.

  • 4

    Gear is detached from the trip

    What to carry, how to fix it and where to buy it are separate searches.

Equip: the ShopIn build

A Shop for the ride, kept outside the app.

Physical goods only, bought on myto-moto.com.

  • Myto Originals

    Our own products. Myto earns the margin.

  • Curated third party

    Chosen on stated criteria. Myto earns a commission.

    Original, Partner or Affiliate, in words.

    In build: gear in context, a link out, no in-app payment.

GMV is not Myto's income. Physical goods sit outside in-app purchase (Apple 3.1.3(e), Google Payments policy). Concept screen; the flat lay is illustrative. Base: 5% of active riders open the link, 3% order, average order ₹1,800, Originals 50% of orders at 40% margin, commission 10%.

Advertising and partnershipsHypothesis

Commerce never touches trust.

Advertising is deferred. These rules are fixed now.

  • Always labelled

    Sponsored, Partner, Affiliate or Original, in words.

  • Never influences safety

    Not conditions, access status, search order or moderation.

  • Never sells location

    No location, ride or contact data. Aggregate counts only.

  • No ads in safety flows

    Not in Help, SOS, check-in, live group view or recording.

  • No advertising identifiers

    No cross-app tracking.

  • Curated means chosen

    By Myto, on stated criteria, not by bid.

Go to marketPlanned

Start where the verified trails are.

Bengaluru and the weekend-ride radius, then only if it works.

Region

Four approved trails, all in or beside Bengaluru. Other states: coming soon.

Founding cohort

50 to 100 contributors by invitation, club road captains first.

Content

Trail of the month, ride reports with GPX, short Fix-it guides, yearly recap cards.

Partners

Clubs, curated gear brands, route homestays and mechanics. None contracted.
